Coram : SWATANTER KUMAR*, RANJAN GOGOI
Penal Code, 1860 - s.302 rlw s.34 - Murder- Conviction A B of appellant and two others u/s.302 rlw s.34 by trial court - High Court while upholding the conviction of appellant C acquitted the other two accused - Plea of appellant that the informant PW1 had turned hostile and the FIR not being evidence, discredited the entire prosecution case; that the dying declaration made by the deceased was not reliable and that the injuries found on the o person of appellant were not explained by the prosecution - Held: Merely because PW1 had turned hostile, it cannot be said that the FIR lost
Decision Date : 10-07-2012 | Case No : CRIMINAL APPEAL No. 106/2010 | Disposal Nature : Dismissed | Bench : 2 Judges
